column1: # docs/doc_shape.tsv — every hand-written document's declared SHAPE, read by
# Opened 14z-122 by the documentation rationalization pass.
#   REFERENCE  themed reference material: no session-shaped headers (a
#              is allowed and stripped before the check)
#   REGISTER   the three gotchas buckets: topical entries whose headers
#              carry a "(paid: 14z-N)" cost suffix — same header rule
#   LOG        an append-only chronology BY DESIGN (patch_notes, audits):
#   HIST       a superseded record or a `<name>_history.md` twin: no header
#              lint, and NO `**[PFX-N]**` anchor may live in it
#   ORIENT     docs/NEXT_SESSION.md: exactly one `# ` header, no `(HISTORY`
#              header — its history lives in the twin
#   INDEX      a registry/index document: no header lint
#   GENERATED  written by a committed tool, gated elsewhere: untouched here
#   EXEMPT     out of the pass's scope (session logs)
#   PENDING    not yet rationalized: lint SKIPPED; must be empty at the end
#              of the pass (--no-pending, the ci gate's final mode)
# history_twin: "-" or the sibling file that holds this document's moved
#              chronology; it must exist and be classed HIST.
# requires:    "-" or comma-separated of: banner (a "**STATUS" line in the
#              first 40 lines), atlas-rows (every `## ` section names an
# --- project/tables (chars/ is generated wholesale and excluded from the walk)
